name: agentbox
description: Email for agents with browser mailbox connections, scoped permissions and persistent reply waits.

api_key.title: Inbox-scoped API key
api_key.description: A read-only, review or allowlisted autonomous key issued by your AgentBox operator. Never use a mailbox password.

api_url.title: AgentBox API URL
api_url.description: The base URL of your AgentBox server. Use HTTPS except for a local demo.
